result.disposition: All 15 frozen evidence-found attempts now have source-reuse dispositions. Current exact manufacturer rechecks document the Cyclone ET component list, frame material and 9.2 kg net-weight claim; T10 Pro drivetrain options; and the R7120 qualitative chassis statement. The Cyclone Sport candidate was narrowed to the supported drivetrain family after its old exact manufacturer URL returned 404. Unmapped or conflicting claims remain qualified or open.

field_results.caveat: The listing supports a hydraulic RS/Sensah mechanical 2x12 alloy-wheel option family. Production-batch parts and retained-generation mapping remain unknown.
The possible Gravel V3 generations support a carbon frame, but the retained revision is unresolved and its fork material is unverified. Grade, lay-up and molding remain unpublished.

Current exact page supports WheelTop EDS TX 2x12, SENICX PRF 34/50 crank, Sunshine 11-34 cassette, SUMC chain, WheelTop hydraulic disc brakes, RS AL7005 W21xH38 wheels and RS 700x28C tires. It displays a 420x90 high-modulus-carbon cockpit but later says every build uses 400x90 alloy; the option mapping remains unresolved.
Exact ET page identifies a high-modulus-carbon frame and full-carbon fork; model-specific grade, lay-up and molding are unpublished.

The exact ET gallery and official-page-embed provenance remain, but the stored image URL was marked unreachable on 2026-09-24. The 2026-09-25 page recheck did not test that asset URL or grant redistribution rights. No image file or hosting change was made.
The exact R7120 page describes aerodynamic stability and efficient power delivery, without a stiffness measurement or protocol. Candidate name is R7120 while its stored ID suffix 7170 differs.

The listed ET build has the recorded drivetrain, crank, cassette, chain, brakes, wheels and tires. The cockpit dimensions/material remain retired and open because the same page conflicts between 420x90 carbon and 400x90 alloy.
The exact ET page supports a high-modulus-carbon frame and full-carbon fork; model-specific grade and lay-up are unpublished.
Manufacturer labels net weight as 9.2 kg / 9,200 g; size, pedals, accessories and weighing protocol are unstated.

Saved exact sources support a shared RETROSPEC/SENSAH hydraulic 2x12 family across both wheel builds. Detailed component model names were removed from the candidate fact because their source summaries did not support them; the current official URL returned 404.

The 9.5 kg seller claim is not mapped to the retained carbon-wheel build; the exact alloy-wheel selection lists 9.9 kg. The 9.5 kg number remains labelled as an unmapped seller claim, not a verified build weight.
The marketplace listing and brand-attributable video index identify Storm Knight/White Knight as an R10 Pro Shuntai 22-speed configuration, not a separate generation; detailed BOM remains unknown.
Current page offers SENSAH HRD6900, WheelTop EDS TX wireless and Shimano 105 R7120 hydraulic 2x12 builds. The retained mainland price card is not mapped to a selected option.
The saved exact manufacturer page states no frame/fork/seatpost/wheel materials. The current exact-page recheck timed out; no material value is assigned.
Current JD listing title does not identify frame-specific material and no exact manufacturer page was found. Frame material, fork construction, carbon grade and lay-up stay unverified.
